ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document identifies acne among chronic skin conditions for which Ayurveda may be considered as an additional treatment approach.
precautions: Do not interpret this source as evidence that Ayurveda alone cures acne.
Severe skin disease or disease not responding to Ayurvedic treatment requires appropriate referral.
when_to_seek_care: Seek appropriate medical evaluation for severe, progressive, infected, or treatment-resistant skin disease.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document identifies mild-to-moderate anxiety disorder as a situation where Ayurveda may be considered.
precautions: Ayurvedic care should not replace urgent psychiatric care for severe illness.
The source describes Ayurveda management within a cross-referral framework rather than as a universal cure.
when_to_seek_care: Urgent professional mental-health assessment is required for suicidal behavior, psychosis, severe symptoms, or other serious psychiatric warning signs.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document includes mild-to-moderate asthma without complications or a serious underlying cause among respiratory conditions that may be referred to Ayurveda.
precautions: Ayurvedic guidance must not replace prescribed emergency or controller treatment.
when_to_seek_care: Emergency medical care is required for severe or rapidly worsening breathing problems.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document includes common cases of acute bronchitis without complications or serious underlying causes among respiratory conditions that may be referred to Ayurveda.
precautions: Do not assume every cough or bronchitis-like illness is suitable for Ayurvedic management.
Serious underlying respiratory disease requires appropriate medical assessment.
when_to_seek_care: Seek medical evaluation when respiratory symptoms are severe, worsening, or associated with concerning signs.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document identifies mild-to-moderate depression as a situation where Ayurveda may be considered.
precautions: Ayurveda should not replace urgent psychiatric treatment for severe depression.
The source supports a cross-referral/add-on framework.
when_to_seek_care: Urgent professional mental-health care is required when there is suicidal behavior, psychosis, severe deterioration, or other serious psychiatric symptoms.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document includes eczema among chronic skin conditions where Ayurveda may be considered as an add-on approach.
precautions: Severe skin infections and serious skin disease require appropriate medical evaluation.
Do not interpret cross-referral guidance as proof of cure.
when_to_seek_care: Seek medical evaluation for severe, infected, rapidly worsening, or treatment-resistant eczema.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document includes chronic and recurrent gastritis among gastrointestinal conditions for which Ayurveda management may be considered.
precautions: Complicated gastrointestinal disease requires medical care.
Do not assume persistent abdominal symptoms are simple gastritis.
when_to_seek_care: Seek medical evaluation for bleeding, severe pain, persistent vomiting, weight loss, or other serious gastrointestinal warning signs.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document lists headache and migraine among neurological conditions that may be considered for Ayurveda after appropriate assessment.
precautions: A new or unusually severe headache requires appropriate medical assessment.
Ayurvedic guidance should not delay emergency evaluation.
when_to_seek_care: Urgent medical assessment is appropriate for sudden severe headache, neurological deficits, altered consciousness, head injury, or other serious neurological signs.

ayurvedic_perspective: The AYUSH cross-referral document identifies osteoarthritis among joint disorders that may be managed through Ayurveda within its cross-referral framework. It also describes Ayurvedic research and integrative treatment protocols for osteoarthritis.
precautions: Severe pain, trauma, deformity, or rapidly worsening joint symptoms require medical assessment.
Do not interpret the source as establishing Ayurveda as a replacement for all conventional treatment.
warning_signs: Severe or rapidly worsening joint pain
Loss of function requiring urgent assessment
when_to_seek_care: Seek appropriate medical assessment for severe, rapidly worsening, traumatic, or function-threatening joint symptoms.
